name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael Costa's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. Initially trained in engineering, he transitioned after witnessing a major security breach at a local karting event. Disgusted by the lapse in safety, he dedicated himself to mastering security protocols, risk assessment, and crowd control, eventually earning a reputation for meticulousness.

At Arrow McLaren, Rafael is known for his no-nonsense approach. He believes in proactive security measures and drills, constantly refining protocols to anticipate and neutralize potential threats. He emphasizes teamwork and training, molding his security team into a cohesive, highly-responsive unit. 

What sets Rafael apart is his calm demeanor during crisis situations. His ability to quickly assess the situation, devise a plan, and issue clear instructions has proven invaluable in several high-pressure incidents, earning him the respect of both his team and the drivers.

physical.description: Rafael is a powerfully built man with a stern, watchful gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Insists on walking the entire perimeter of the track or garage area at least once a day.
Has a habit of silently mouthing numbers while observing crowds or analyzing security footage.
